extension.summary: Populate missing metadata and artwork for existing library items.
extension.description: Library Updatarr scans your existing Kodi video library for movies, TV shows, and episodes with missing posters, fanart, or metadata. It applies local artwork and NFO files first, then uses your installed online scrapers to fill remaining gaps — without wiping the database or scanning for new files.
extension.news: 2.2.2 — Remove from library: video types only (not music). 2.2.1 — tvshow.path warning.

extension.summary: Selects a preferred subtitle when playback starts, and can seek back so subtitles appear
extension.description: Subtitle Enforcer turns on the first available subtitle from up to five languages, in the order you set. A priority can be Original language, Default language, a listed language, Kodi's own subtitle language, or any language name or code. Original language follows the film, even when the audio is a dub, and TMDB wins if it disagrees with the file or the library. Default language uses the audio language the file marks as default. Leave the TMDB API key empty to use TMDBHelper's key. Each language can include hearing impaired (HI), SDH, and forced tracks, and the choice can follow whether you understand the audio. Trailers, extras, and individual shows can be skipped or given their own rule. It can also wait a few seconds after playback starts and seek backward, which makes Kodi show embedded subtitles that otherwise stay hidden until a manual seek.
extension.news: Version 2.4.0 gives a show or movie its own subtitle language, including the title that is playing.

extension.summary: Refresh library ratings by media type
extension.description: Refresh scraped ratings for movies, TV shows, episodes, or all of those types. IMDb scores come from IMDb's non-commercial dataset files. TMDb is the main online source, and a score already cached by TMDbHelper is reused. OMDb adds Rotten Tomatoes critic and Metacritic scores. Trakt adds a public Trakt score. Requests stay inside the limits published by those services. Personal star ratings are left alone. This product uses the TMDb API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDb.
extension.news: v1.2.8 - Use TMDbHelper's cached TMDb score when no TMDb key is set v1.2.7 - Show the summary after a finished update v1.2.6 - OMDb requests use the documented apikey and IMDb id lookup v1.2.5 - OMDb requires an API key; the free key allows 1,000 requests a day v1.2.4 - Option to write only ratings the item does not already have v1.2.3 - Download IMDb data now, from the settings, as well as on the automatic schedule v1.2.2 - Choose a local folder for the IMDb downloads and the SQLite index v1.2.1 - Local IMDb database is a provider switch, with the other providers - Media type switches apply to All video and the schedule v1.2.0 - Reuse a TMDb score and IDs already cached by TMDbHelper - Keep TMDb, Trakt, and OMDb requests inside the limits those services publish v1.1.0 - IMDb scores from the IMDb dataset files, refreshed about every 30 days - Run daily at chosen times, or on an hourly interval - Background runs, a summary, and a log of the last 10 runs - Skip a write unless the rating moved by more than the chosen amount v1.0.0 - Update movies, TV shows, episodes, or all three - Context menu for the selected item, its media type, or the whole video library - Optional scheduled run

extension.summary: Selects a preferred audio track when playback starts
extension.description: Audio Enforcer selects the first available audio track from up to five choices when a video starts. A choice can be the original language, the file's default track, Kodi's audio language, or a specific language. The original language comes from the file, and from TheMovieDB Helper when the file does not say. Commentary tracks can be skipped. Trailers, extras, and individual shows or movies can each use their own choice.
extension.news: Version 1.0.0 selects a preferred audio track when playback starts, including the original language, the file default, and a language for one show.

extension.summary: Github repository for Skippy - Video Segment Skipper for Kodi and companion Segment Editor
extension.description: Installs Skippy, Segment Editor and other Kodi addons

extension.summary: Shows Jellyfin trickplay seek thumbnails during video scrubbing.
extension.description: Reads or generates Jellyfin trickplay sprite tiles alongside your media, crops preview frames with Pillow while you scrub, and shows them via skin window properties. Optional ffmpeg generator writes .trickplay sidecars; use Install preview tools for Pillow (preview) and ffmpeg (generation). Use Show addon status / Install skin snippet in settings (DialogSeekBar.xml for most skins; VideoFullScreen.xml for Bello). Generation/HDR requires ffmpeg, ffprobe, and optionally dovi_tool.

extension.summary: Kodi GUI wrapper (script.texture.cache) for Milhouse texturecache
extension.description: Texture Cache Utility (script.texture.cache) is a Kodi GUI wrapper for Milhouse's texturecache. Cache artwork, prune, clean orphans, and run QA from Kodi with presets, progress, cancel, scheduled maintenance, and a library context menu. Bundled engine: https://github.com/xbmc/texturecache
extension.news: 2.0.6: Import local artwork is in Pick commands as well as Run preset.

extension.summary: Skippy: skip, mark, and edit video segments (intros, recaps, credits, and more) using local or online data.
extension.description: All-in-one Kodi companion for chapter-style workflows: automatically skip or prompt on segments, mark new ranges during playback, and open a full segment editor for .edl and Matroska-style chapters.xml sidecars. Configurable segment types (skip mode, aliases, EDL numbers), dialogs, and optional online lookups (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate keymaps for marker (skippy_marker.xml) and editor (skippy_editor.xml).

Konfigurerbare segmenttyper (springtilstand, aliasser, EDL-numre), dialoger og valgfri onlineopslag (TheIntroDB / IntroDB.app). Separate tastaturtilknytninger til markør (skippy_marker.xml) og editor (skippy_editor.xml).
